title: Insertion Sort
problemStatement: Sort an array using Insertion Sort.
intuition: Maintain a sorted prefix. Take next element and insert it into the correct position by shifting larger elements right — like sorting cards in hand.

approaches.title: Insertion sort
approaches.idea: For i=1..n-1, insert a[i] into sorted a[0..i-1].
approaches.whyWorks: Invariant: a[0..i-1] sorted after step i.

followUps: Why good for nearly sorted / small n?
interviewInsight: Insertion is the practical O(n²) sort — adaptive + stable + good on nearly sorted data.
